matrix_target: 20x20 seed toward a future 100x100 inversion matrix

tests.title: Hidden-oracle audit
tests.description: Detects preprocessing or compilation that first solves SAT or another target problem before emitting a simple object.

tests.title: Two-sided correctness and coverage
tests.description: Checks soundness, completeness, termination, and complete coverage of SAT and UNSAT cases.

tests.title: Witness or refutation recovery
tests.description: Requires polynomial reconstruction of a satisfying assignment or independently checkable refutation.

tests.title: Bit-complexity audit
tests.description: Charges coefficient, integer, matrix-entry, and intermediate-value bit lengths.

tests.title: DNNF or knowledge-compilation transfer
tests.description: Attempts to translate the mechanism into a representation with known size lower bounds.

tests.title: Resolution or Res(XOR) transfer
tests.description: Attempts to place the mechanism inside a named proof system and inherit proof-size lower bounds.

tests.title: Communication-protocol transfer
tests.description: Extracts a low-cost protocol from a compact lift, decomposition, or certificate.

tests.title: Polyhedral extension-complexity transfer
tests.description: Tests whether the mechanism yields a forbidden small LP or polyhedral extended formulation.

tests.title: SDP extension-complexity transfer
tests.description: Tests whether the mechanism yields a polynomial-size SDP relaxation contradicted by known lower bounds.

tests.title: Lovasz-theta gap test
tests.description: Measures whether the first theta relaxation separates the target integer value by a certified gap.

tests.title: Theta-rank growth test
tests.description: Measures how many theta or related SDP hierarchy levels are needed for exactness.

tests.title: Auxiliary-variable stability
tests.description: Checks whether lower bounds survive polynomially many definitional or extension variables.

tests.title: Affine-elimination stability
tests.description: Checks preservation under Gaussian elimination, invertible affine substitutions, and XOR extraction.

tests.title: Moment-matrix size audit
tests.description: Charges the dimension and construction cost of moment or Gram matrices.

tests.title: Dual-certificate rationality
tests.description: Requires polynomial-bit rational dual certificates rather than floating-point solver output.

tests.title: Explicitness and uniformity
tests.description: Rejects random existence, nonuniform advice, or unconstructible hard families.

tests.title: Natural-proofs barrier audit
tests.description: Checks constructivity, largeness, and usefulness conditions against pseudorandom-function barriers.

tests.title: Relativization and algebrization audit
tests.description: Checks whether the proposed argument survives or is blocked by known oracle-style barriers.

tests.title: Proof existence versus proof search
tests.description: Separates short-proof existence, verification, and deterministic polynomial-time discovery.

tests.title: Inheritance and non-duplication audit
tests.description: Checks that the child adds a material obligation beyond its registered parents.
